transcript.answer: Lore's `auto-merge` run waits until four things hold: (1) CI is green, (2) no review thread is open, (3) Lore's own review stands approved on the pull request's current head commit, and (4) the pull request has been open for the minimum age (`auto_merge.min_age_hours`, 24 hours by default). Only then does the `approve` station approve it. It approves as the lore-reviewer App if that is installed, and as Lore's own App otherwise. Red CI, a conflict or an open review thread is not approved. It was originally sent to the `auto-merge-fix` agent, which gets three rounds at most. A later commit (1731e90) says auto merge should only wait and approve, and that the loop that opened a pull request keeps it mergeable. So I can't say for certain that `auto-merge-fix` still does the fixing. Open threads from earlier Lore reviews are what keep the loop off a pull request whose findings nobody has addressed. For that reason PR #3433 stopped an approving re-check from resolving those earlier threads.

judgements.reason: The answer covers all five conditions in the gold answer: red CI, a conflict, an open review thread, a review not approved on the head commit, and an age below min_age_hours (24 by default), and nothing it adds contradicts the gold.
